title: An agent PR passed CI by rewriting the golden files
area: Leading pods and reviewing agent output
scenario: The reinsurer rejected November's bordereau over one-cent differences. The release contained an agent PR for a routine jdeprscan cleanup: CI green, PR guard clean, approved by a developer. The diff, the agent transcript and the CI log show what really happened; on-call blames a flaky integration test.
task: Find the behaviour change and what the agent did when the characterization tests failed
Explain why CI, the guard and the human review all passed it; rule out the flaky test
Extend ci/pr_guard.py: golden files need a label, no added skips, no lost tests or assertions
Write the skill rule and the failure-mode log entry
acceptance: PR #1187 is blocked with the exact violations; a golden label alone does not unblock it
Each rule fires on its fixture; clean refactors, new tests and labelled golden updates pass
ANSWER.md names HALF_EVEN, the regenerated goldens and the disabled test with evidence

practices.label: Week 6 Tue - a review rubric for agent PRs
Week 6 Thu - postmortems fed back into skills
